title: kirigami.yaml
description: Configuration file for the Kirigami static site generator (@kirigami/kirigami, v1.4.0). Must sit at the project root and be named exactly 'kirigami.yaml'. Read by every `kiri` command (build, export, watch, run) via bin/config.js.

kirigami.description: Core project settings. Every key is extracted as a PHP variable and made available in every page template, before.php, after.php, and any PHP file listed under prepros.includes.

project.description: Human-readable project/site name. REQUIRED — build fails immediately if missing. Printed in the CLI banner for `kiri build`/`kiri export`/`kiri watch` and available as the PHP variable $project in every template.

baseurl.description: Root URL of the deployed site, without a trailing slash. REQUIRED — build fails immediately if missing. Used by @kirigami/php-prepros to build absolute <loc> entries in the generated sitemap.xml, and available as the PHP variable $baseurl.

root.description: Path, relative to the project root, to the directory containing your `_*.php` source pages. REQUIRED. Build fails immediately if missing or if the resolved path does not exist on disk. All task `entry` paths (esbuild, sass) and prepros rendering are relative to this directory.

banner.description: Path, relative to the project root, to a text file stamped as a comment header on every exported .js / .css / .html file (and sitemap.xml) during `kiri export`. Optional — with no file set, kiri uses its bundled ASCII banner template instead. Either way the file keeps its placeholder tokens on disk; kiri fills them from this `kirigami` block on every build/export: ###DATE### (today, English long date + 24h local time), ###YEAR###, ###PROJECT###, ###AUTHOR###, ###EMAIL###, ###REPO### (falls back to the repo derived from a *.github.io baseurl), ###BASEURL###. A line whose value(s) resolve empty is dropped ("Author: Foo <>" becomes "Author: Foo"). `kiri create` writes a starter banner.txt to the project root. Build fails only if a `banner` path is set and the file is missing.

^(?!project$|baseurl$|root$|banner$|json.description: Any additional key is free-form project data (string, number, boolean, list, or nested map — anything valid YAML). Every key is extracted as a PHP variable of the same name (e.g. `author:` becomes $author) and is available in page templates, before.php, after.php, and any PHP file listed under prepros.includes. Common examples used across Kirigami projects: author, person, jobtitle, email, facebook (or other social links), area, gtag, description, knowsabout (list), keywords (list). The @kirigami/php-prepros META/LD classes read some of these by convention when the top-level `seo` block is present.

seo.description: Top-level block. The unified SEO surface: configuration for @kirigami/php-prepros' META class (standard SEO / social <meta> and <link> tags — description, keywords, robots, author, generator, Open Graph, Twitter Card, canonical, favicon, …), plus a nested `jsonld` sub-block (below) for the LD class (schema.org JSON-LD). Replaces the old separate top-level `meta:`/`jsonld:` blocks — one block, one mental model for a project's whole SEO setup. META's automatic injection is OPT-IN: it happens only when this block is present. An empty map (`seo: {}`) is enough to turn it on, deriving everything from the loose keys of the `kirigami` block and each page's PHPDOC (@title, @description / @abstract, @keywords, @image, @robots, @og_type). JSON-LD is a separate, independent opt-in nested under `jsonld` (a project can have one without the other). A tag/script the page's layout already hand-writes is left untouched either way. Omit the block entirely and nothing is injected (explicit META::tag()/meta_tag() and LD::add()/ld_add() calls from templates still emit). Set to `false`, or `{ "auto": false }`, to keep the config values but stop META's automatic injection — `jsonld.auto` controls JSON-LD independently. Per-page PHPDOC tags: @meta false (skip the page, or @meta_ignore true), @meta_title, @meta_description, @meta_keywords, @meta_image, @meta_robots, @meta_type, @canonical <url> — plus LD's own @ld_* tags, see `jsonld` below.

auto.description: Whether to automatically inject META's generated tags into each page's <head>. Defaults to true once this block exists; set false to keep the block for its config values while placing tags by hand with META::tags() / meta_tags(). Independent of `jsonld.auto`.

titleFormat.description: Template for the composed <title> / og:title / twitter:title on a normal page. Tokens: {title} (the page's @title), {project}, {tagline}. Dangling separators left by an empty token are trimmed.

titleFormatHome.description: Title template used when the page has no @title (or its @title equals `project`) — i.e. the home page and section landing pages without their own title.

description.description: Default site description, used on pages that declare no @description / @abstract of their own. Defaults to `jsonld.description`, then the loose `description` key.

keywords.description: Default <meta name="keywords"> content. A list or a comma-separated string. Defaults to `jsonld.keywords`, then the loose `keywords` key. A page's @keywords overrides it.

robots.description: Default <meta name="robots"> directive. A page's @robots overrides it; `robots: false` (or @robots false) omits the tag.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag emitted as <meta name="language"> and, with the dash turned into an underscore, as og:locale. Defaults to `jsonld.lang`, then the loose `lang` / `language` key, then `en`.

generator.description: <meta name="generator"> content. Set a string to override, or `false` to omit the tag.

author.description: <meta name="author"> content. Defaults to the loose `author` key, then `jsonld.person`'s name.

designer.description: <meta name="designer"> content. Defaults to the loose `designer` key; not emitted unless set.

themeColor.description: <meta name="theme-color"> content (a CSS color). Not emitted unless set.

image.description: Default og:image / twitter:image — an absolute URL or a path relative to `baseurl`. Defaults to `jsonld.image`, then `jsonld.logo`, then the loose `image` / `ogimage` key. A page's @image overrides it.

ogType.description: Default og:type. A page's @og_type overrides it.

twitter.description: Twitter handle(s) for twitter:site / twitter:creator. A bare string (with or without the leading @, or a full profile URL) fills both; an object accepts `site` and `creator` separately.

canonical.description: Emit <link rel="canonical"> (URL derived from the page's file path + `baseurl`, or a page's @canonical). Set false to never emit it.

favicon.description: <link rel="icon">. A path (page-relative when it is a bare filename) sets it explicitly; `true` forces the default `favicon.ico`; omitted, it is auto-detected on disk at the source root; `false` disables it.

appleTouchIcon.description: <link rel="apple-touch-icon">. Same resolution as `favicon`; default file `apple-touch-icon.png`.

humans.description: <link rel="author" type="text/plain">. Same resolution as `favicon`; default file `humans.txt`.

jsonld.description: Sub-block. Configuration for @kirigami/php-prepros' LD class, which generates schema.org JSON-LD and injects it as a <script type="application/ld+json"> block into every page's <head>. Automatic injection is a separate OPT-IN from the rest of `seo:`: it happens only when this sub-block is present. An empty map (`seo: { jsonld: {} }`) is enough to turn it on, deriving everything from the loose keys of the `kirigami` block (project, baseurl, description, person, jobtitle, email, area, knowsabout, keywords, and any social-network URL keys such as facebook) and the rest of the `seo:` block (description, keywords, image, language); the keys below override those inferences. Omit the sub-block entirely and nothing is injected (explicit LD::add()/ld_add() calls from templates still emit). Set to `false`, or `{ "auto": false }`, to keep the config values but stop the automatic injection — independent of `seo.auto`. A BreadcrumbList is built for every non-home page from the _index.php ancestor trail (no @breadcrumb opt-in). Per-page PHPDOC tags on a template: @ld false (skip the page), @ld_type <Type> (page node @type, e.g. AboutPage / Article / Service), @ld_title, @ld_description, @ld_image, @ld_published, @ld_modified, @ld_breadcrumb false.

auto.description: Whether to automatically inject the generated <script type="application/ld+json"> into each page's <head>. Defaults to true once this sub-block exists; set false to keep it for its config values while placing the script by hand with LD::script()/ld_script(). A page that already hand-writes an application/ld+json script is never touched.

type.description: schema.org @type for the site's main entity node (@id '#organization').

name.description: Name of the main entity / WebSite. Defaults to `project`.

description.description: Description of the main entity / WebSite. Defaults to the sibling `seo.description`, then the loose `description` key.

logo.description: Organization logo, absolute URL or a path relative to `baseurl`. Emitted as an ImageObject (@id '#logo').

image.description: Default social/preview image, absolute URL or a path relative to `baseurl`. Defaults to `logo`.

sameAs.description: Profile URLs for the main entity (schema.org sameAs). Merged with any recognised social-network URL keys found loose in the `kirigami` block (facebook, instagram, linkedin, github, youtube, mastodon, …).

email.description: Contact email for the main entity. Defaults to the loose `email` key.

telephone.description: Contact phone for the main entity. Defaults to the loose `telephone`/`phone` key.

address.description: PostalAddress properties for the main entity (streetAddress, addressLocality, addressRegion, postalCode, addressCountry, …).

areaServed.description: Geographic area served by the main entity. Defaults to the loose `area` key.

knowsAbout.description: Topics the main entity is knowledgeable about. Defaults to the loose `knowsabout` key.

keywords.description: Keywords for the WebSite node. Defaults to the sibling `seo.keywords`, then the loose `keywords` key.

person.description: The key Person behind the site (@id '#person'), linked to the Organization via worksFor/founder. A bare string is taken as the person's name; an object accepts any schema.org Person property (name, jobTitle, email, url, sameAs, …). Defaults to the loose `person` + `jobtitle` + `email` keys.

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag emitted as inLanguage on the WebSite/WebPage nodes. Defaults to the loose `lang`/`language` key, then to `en`.

search.description: URL template for a WebSite sitelinks search box (schema.org SearchAction). Must contain the literal token {search_term_string}.

prepros.description: Options passed to @kirigami/php-prepros, the PHP-to-HTML compiler. Presence of this block (even empty) also causes `kiri build`/`kiri export`/`kiri watch` to automatically prepend a forced 'prepros' task that renders every page and regenerates sitemap.xml.

before.description: Path, relative to kirigami.root, to a PHP file included before every page's body (typically your <head>/layout opening).

after.description: Path, relative to kirigami.root, to a PHP file included after every page's body (typically your layout closing).

format.description: Pretty-print the compiled HTML output (4-space indentation via HTML::format(), Dom\HTMLDocument/Lexbor). When false, output is written as-is.

head.description: Auto-wire each page's <head>: a small theme/FOUC guard as the first child of <head>, a <link rel="stylesheet"> for every `sass` task output, and a <script> (no `defer`, before </body>) for every `esbuild` task output — all with a per-page relative path and a cache-busting query. A file already referenced in the page is left alone. Set false to disable, or `head: false` on a single sass/esbuild task to skip just its tag.

network.description: Enables outbound HTTP(S) requests inside the sandboxed WASM PHP runtime. Required for PHPDOC `@tag https://…` annotations that auto-fetch remote .yaml/.json/.md data, and for CURL/SCRAPER classes to reach the network.

mountext.description: Extra file extensions to automatically mount into the virtual filesystem alongside the built-in defaults (.php, .json, .yaml, .yml, .md, .db, .txt). Use for assets your PHP code reads directly. Files with extensions not in this set are simply skipped during automatic mounting — mount them on demand instead with PREPROS::mount() from PHP.

includes.description: PHP files, relative to kirigami.root, `include_once`'d once right after config is loaded — before any page renders. The natural place to call PREPROS::registerTag(), PREPROS::registerHook(), or MD::registerPlugin().

image.description: Options for Kirigami's image autogenerator, which converts source images into an optimized format. Optional — omit entirely to use the defaults below.

format.description: Output image format for the autogenerator.

source.description: Folder containing the source images to process, relative to cwd().

dest.description: Destination folder for the generated images, relative to kirigami.root.

plugins.description: List of Kirigami plugins. Each plugin must use a supported package naming convention.

name.description: Plugin identifier. Must use one of the supported naming conventions: @kirigami/plugin-*, */kirigami-plugin-*, or kirigami-plugin-*.

options.description: Plugin options. Free-form here; each plugin also ships its own JSON Schema (package.json `kirigami.optionsSchema`) which `kiri` validates at build time. Official @kirigami/plugin-* packages have their schema wired in below, so this block gets full editor completion/validation once `name` is set.

allOf.$comment: One block per first-party plugin: when `name` matches, point `options` at that package's options.schema.json (resolved relative to this file's location — a sibling package in the monorepo / on jsdelivr). Third-party plugins keep the free-form `options` above and are validated only at build time.

esbuild.description: Free-form object. Every key/value pair under this block is passed straight through to the esbuild task as extra build parameters — there is no fixed set of allowed keys and no schema-level default values are enforced by Kirigami itself. Whatever you put here is simply merged into the esbuild call for every 'esbuild' task, so refer to esbuild's own BuildOptions documentation (https://esbuild.github.io/api/#build-api) for what's accepted. Writing `esbuild:` with nothing under it (only comments) parses to `null` in YAML, which is equivalent to omitting the block entirely.

sass.description: Free-form object. Every key/value pair under this block is passed straight through to the sass task as extra compile parameters — there is no fixed set of allowed keys and no schema-level default values are enforced by Kirigami itself. Whatever you put here is simply merged into the sass.compile() call for every 'sass' task, so refer to Dart Sass's own Options documentation (https://sass-lang.com/documentation/js-api/interfaces/options/) for what's accepted. Writing `sass:` with nothing under it (only comments) parses to `null` in YAML, which is equivalent to omitting the block entirely.

export.description: Options for `kiri export` (production build). Optional — omit entirely to use the defaults below.

path.description: Output directory for `kiri export`, relative to the project root. A 'dist' task (type: dist) is automatically prepended to the task list with this path, force-run, copying every non-excluded file from kirigami.root into it (skipping files/dirs starting with `_` or `.`, `.scss`, `.map`, and unminified `.js` files) and stamping the project banner on .js/.css/.html files.

ignore.description: Extra gitignore-style patterns (parsed with the `ignore` package) of files/directories to exclude from the export copy, in addition to Kirigami's built-in exclusions.

scripts.description: Named PHP scripts runnable via `kiri run <name>` or automatically fired at pipeline checkpoints via `trigger`. Each script's PHP file must exist at scripts/<name>.php, relative to the project root, and is executed with runenv() from @kirigami/php-prepros (full class library available, kirigami.yaml's `kirigami` block available as PREPROS::$config->data).

name.description: Script identifier. Must match an existing scripts/<name>.php file. Invoke manually with `kiri run <name> [args...]`; extra CLI arguments are forwarded as $argv entries to the PHP script.

mount.description: Glob patterns (relative to the project root) of extra local files to mount into the WASM sandbox before this script runs, in addition to the files auto-mounted from kirigami.root. Useful when the script needs to read files outside of root (e.g. raw image sources).

trigger.description: When set, this script runs automatically at the named pipeline checkpoint, without needing `kiri run` to be called manually. `before-build` fires at the start of both `kiri build` and `kiri export` (as part of before-export's default sequence). `before-export` fires at the very start of `kiri export`, right before `before-build`. `after-export` fires once `kiri export` has finished writing every task's output.

tasks.description: Ordered list of build tasks (in addition to the implicit 'prepros' task auto-added when the top-level `prepros` block is present, and the implicit 'dist' task auto-added during `kiri export`). Executed in array order. `kiri build`/`kiri export` run every task whose type supports building (or that declares `force: true`); `kiri watch` attaches a file watcher to every task whose type supports watching.

oneOf.title: esbuild task
oneOf.description: Bundles and minifies a JS/TS entry point with esbuild. Supports build and watch. Output: <entry-without-ext>.min.js (plus a .map file outside of `kiri export`), next to the entry file.

name.description: Arbitrary label for this task, shown in CLI output.

entry.description: Path to the JS/TS entry point, relative to kirigami.root. Build fails if the file does not exist.

head.description: Whether prepros should auto-inject a <script src> for this task's output into every page (before </body>, no `defer`). Defaults to true when `prepros.head` is on; set false to place the tag yourself.

force.description: Run this task even during commands that would otherwise skip it (e.g. force build-only tasks during `kiri watch`'s initial pass). Rarely needed manually — Kirigami sets this internally for its own implicit tasks.

oneOf.title: sass task
oneOf.description: Compiles a Sass/SCSS entry point with Dart Sass, minified with csso on export. Supports build and watch. Output: <entry-without-ext>.min.css (plus a .css.map file outside of `kiri export`), next to the entry file.

name.description: Arbitrary label for this task, shown in CLI output.

entry.description: Path to the .scss/.sass entry point, relative to kirigami.root. Build fails if the file does not exist.

head.description: Whether prepros should auto-inject a <link rel="stylesheet"> for this task's output into every page's <head>. Defaults to true when `prepros.head` is on; set false to place the tag yourself.

force.description: Run this task even during commands that would otherwise skip it.

oneOf.title: prepros task
oneOf.description: Renders PHP page(s) via @kirigami/php-prepros and regenerates sitemap.xml. You do NOT normally need to declare this manually — simply having a top-level `prepros` block in kirigami.yaml causes Kirigami to auto-prepend one, forced, on every build/export/watch. Declare it explicitly only if you need a second, differently-scoped prepros pass.

name.description: Arbitrary label for this task, shown in CLI output.

target.description: Optional single file or subdirectory (relative to kirigami.root) to render instead of the whole source tree.

oneOf.title: dist task
oneOf.description: Copies kirigami.root into an output directory, preserving structure, skipping files/dirs starting with `_` or `.`, `.scss` and `.map` files, and unminified `.js` files, then stamps the project banner on .js/.css/.html output. You do NOT normally need to declare this manually — `kiri export` auto-prepends one, forced, using `export.path`/`export.ignore`. Declare it explicitly only for an additional, differently-scoped copy pass.

name.description: Arbitrary label for this task, shown in CLI output.

path.description: Destination directory for the copy, emptied before every run.

ignore.description: Gitignore-style patterns of files/directories to additionally exclude from the copy.
